title: SOC Estimator (Coulomb Counting)
text: State of charge estimator with Coulomb counting, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Specify Current input as cell current(s)} sets the option to specify current input port, {Cell capacity, AH (A*Hr)} sets the battery capacity when fully charged and {Algorithm data type} sets the option to choose data type for block algorithm. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: InitialSOC
ports.summary: Initial state of charge, unitless scalar | vector

ports.name: SOC
ports.summary: Battery state of charge scalar | vector

params.name: Specify Current input as cell current(s)
params.values: Option to specify current input port as vector on (default) | off

params.name: Cell capacity, AH (A*Hr)
params.values: Battery capacity when fully charged 27 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Algorithm data type
params.values: Option to choose data type for block algorithm Inherit: auto (default) | double | single |
